name: minecraft
author: yunyun
short: Minecraft Java server monitor — status, player tracking, join/leave notifications
description: Monitor a Minecraft Java Edition server: query live status and player list, receive Discord notifications whenever players join/leave or the server goes offline/online. Per-guild config with IP:port setting, channel selection, and an enable/disable toggle. No external dependencies — uses the native Server List Ping protocol.
install_msg: Loaded! Admin: set the server with `mc set <host> [port]`, choose a channel with `mc channel #channel`, then start monitoring with `mc enable`. Run `mc help` for the full command list.
